identity_evolution_policy: Schema overlay version is independent of biological identity schema version. Additive representation changes preserve biological source IDs unless identity semantics change.
identity_policy: frozen peptide_key, sample_peptide_id, origin_id, candidate_key and candidate_id
coordinate_system: one-based-inclusive genomic coordinates; transcript blocks in transcription orientation
novel_nt_intervals: Newly present splice sequence, using altered-transcript one-based-inclusive start_nt/end_nt and oriented reference_coordinates, contig and strand; empty for deletion-only structures and fusion parental sequence
inserted_sequence_aa: Translated codons overlapping novel_nt_intervals; union with split-junction residues and novel-frame tails forms novel_aa
inserted_sequence_reference_comparison: inserted_sequence_no_single_reference; exact whole-reference-proteome self search remains independent
